values.combineMapPrompt:
You are summarizing ONE internal company meeting. The meeting data is below in JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) format.

{text}

Write a concise summary with these sections:
- Department & meeting: department name, title, date
- Key points: 3-4 bullets with the most important facts and numbers
- Decisions: what was agreed
- Action items: task, owner, deadline, priority
- Risks: main risks mentioned
- Needs from other departments: only dependencies explicitly described in the meeting data. If only a department name is listed without details, write just the name.

Use only information from the meeting data. Do not invent facts. Keep all numbers exactly as given.
values.prompt:
Below are summaries of several morning meetings from different departments of the same company.

{text}

Write a short "Morning Meetings Summary" for company management. Maximum 250 words.

Sections:
1. Overview: 2 sentences on the overall situation.
2. Department highlights: 1-2 bullets per department, most important facts and numbers only.
3. Key dependencies: max 3 bullets, only dependencies explicitly mentioned in the summaries.
4. Top 3 risks: one line each.
5. Urgent deadlines: only high or critical priority items due in the next 7 days (date, owner, task).

Use only information from the summaries. Do not guess or add assumptions. Keep numbers exactly as given.
